questions.question_text: Which planet is known as the 'Red Planet'?
questions.explanation: Mars appears red due to iron oxide on its surface.

questions.question_text: Who is considered the father of modern economics?
questions.explanation: Adam Smith authored 'The Wealth of Nations' and is widely regarded as the father of modern economics.

questions.question_text: Which organization is responsible for global health standards?
questions.explanation: The World Health Organization (WHO) coordinates international public health initiatives.

questions.question_text: Which element makes up the majority of the Earth's atmosphere?
questions.explanation: Nitrogen makes up approximately 78% of the Earth's atmosphere.

questions.question_text: In which continent is the Sahara Desert located?
questions.explanation: The Sahara is the largest hot desert in the world, located in North Africa.

questions.question_text: Who was the first person to step on the moon?
questions.explanation: Neil Armstrong made history as the first human to walk on the lunar surface in 1969.

questions.question_text: What is the capital city of Japan?
questions.explanation: Tokyo is the capital and largest city of Japan.

questions.question_text: Which ocean is the largest on Earth?
questions.explanation: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest of Earth's oceanic divisions.

questions.question_text: Which chemical element is represented by the symbol 'Au'?
questions.explanation: Au is derived from the Latin word 'Aurum', meaning gold.

questions.question_text: Which river is known as the longest river in the world?
questions.explanation: The Nile is historically considered the longest river on Earth.

questions.question_text: Which international body has its headquarters in Geneva?
questions.explanation: The WHO is headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland.
